The centred 2 × 2 × 2 cube loses a bore of radius 1/2 along Z. The
cylinder removes volume π/2 and two discs totalling π/2 in area. Its wall
adds area 2π. The bounds and centroid follow from the cube and symmetry.

The workplane is 10¹⁷ units from the stock. Its offset must leave the bore
identical to one drawn on the stock under ADR-0024 §A. At that distance the
old projection rounded both bounds and both clearances to the same float.
